name: Hong Kong ID Checksum
description: Validates Hong Kong Identity Card numbers (1-2 letters + 6 digits + check character, e.g. A123456(3)). Letters map A=10..Z=35; single-letter IDs are left-padded with the implicit space value 36; values are weighted [9..1] and the total (including the check character, where 'A' = 10) must be divisible by 11.
